Dixon Technologies aims for global top five in manufacturing

Dixon Technologies is expanding its electronics manufacturing operations beyond smartphones, aiming to become one of the top five global manufacturers. The company is pursuing new ventures, partnerships, and has established a second IT hardware plant as part of its growth strategy.
